chapterInfo.content:
4
Yuda mmɔborɔ asetena ne n’animtiabuo
1 # Kwa 1.6, 10 Ao, sɛ sika abiri tumm,
hyerɛmmoɔ pa no asakyera nie!
Wɔatoto kronkronbea aboɔ no
agu mmorɔno nyinaa so.
2Sion mma a wɔn boɔ yɛ den
a wɔde sika amapa kari wɔn no,
ɛsii sɛn na wɔbuu wɔn sɛ dɔteɛ nkukuo,
ɔnwomfoɔ nsa ano adwuma yi?
3Ɛserɛ so kraman mpo twetwe wɔn nufo
ma wɔn mma nnum;
me man babaa adane otirimuɔdenfoɔ
te sɛ ɛserɛ so nsohori.
4Sukɔm ma akɔkoaa
tɛkyerɛma fam ne dodo mu,
mmotafowa srɛ aduane,
obi nni hɔ a ɔbu bi ma wɔn.
5Wɔn a wɔdii adɔkɔdɔkɔdeɛ no
ayɛ pasaa mmorɔno so;
wɔn a wɔyɛne wɔn ɔtankɔkɔɔ soɔ no
yɛ sumina atuu.
6 # Gye 18.20; 19.24-25 Na me man babaa amumuyɛ so akatua
sene Sodom bɔne no deɛ,
ɛno nti na wɔbutuu no amonom,
a ɛnyɛ nsa na ɛsɛe no.
7Ne mmapɔmma ho te sene sukyerɛmma,
wɔhoa nso sene nufosuo;
wɔn honam bere sene ntwoma,
wɔn nipadua te sɛ hoaboɔ.
8Afei deɛ wɔn anim biri sene gyabidie,
wɔhu wɔn mmorɔno so a, wɔnhu wɔn:
Wɔn wedeɛ afemfam wɔn nnompe ho,
akyen wirekyee, ayɛ sɛ dua.
9Wɔn a wɔtotɔ afena ano deɛ yɛ
sene wɔn a wɔtotɔ ɛkɔm ano
a afuo mu nnɔbaeɛ a abɔ wɔn nti
wɔkusa hyeɛ no.
10 # Kwa 2.20 Mmaa a wɔn yam hyehye wɔn
de wɔn nsa noaa wɔn ara wɔn yafumma;
wɔde wɔn yɛɛ aduane,
me man babaa sɛeɛ no mu.
11AWURADE ayi n’abufuhyeɛ no adi awie,
wahwie n’abufuo a ano yɛ den no agu;
wasɔ Sion mu gya
ama no ahye ne nnyinasoɔ.
12Asase so ahemfo
ne wiasefoɔ nyinaa annye anni,
sɛ ɔhohiahiafoɔ ne ɔtamfoɔ
bɛba abɛhyɛne Yerusalem apono mu.
13N’adiyifoɔ bɔne, ne
n’asɔfoɔ amumuyɛ nti na ɛbaa saa;
ma wɔhwiee
teneneefoɔ mogya wɔn mfimfini.
14Wɔkeka sɛ anifirafoɔ wɔ mmorɔno so,
wɔde mogya agugu wɔn ho fi
a enti wɔntumi nka wɔn ntadeɛ.
15Wɔteaa mu kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfiri ha! Mo a mo ho akum!
Mommane, mommane, mommfa mo nsa nnka!
Wɔdwane kɔkyinkyiniiɛ no,
wɔkaa no amanaman mu sɛ:
Wɔrenkɔ so ntena ha bio.
16 # Kwa 5.12; Deut 28.50; Yes 47.6 AWURADE ankasa na apansam wɔn,
ɔrenkɔ so nhwɛ wɔn;
wɔnhwɛ asɔfoɔ anim,
mpanin anim amma nyam.
17Yɛn ani da so rehwɛ
yɛn mmoa a ɛremma no kwan,
yɛn ahwɛeɛ hɔ no, yɛhwɛɛ ɔman
a wɔntumi nnye yɛn nkwa no kwan ara.
18Wɔtoaa yɛn anammɔn,
na yɛantumi annante yɛn mmɔntene so.
Yɛn awieeɛ abɛn, yɛn nna ahi,
aane, yɛn awieeɛ adu.
19Yɛn atifoɔ ho yɛ hare
sene ɔsoro akɔdeɛ;
wɔti yɛn yerɛdɛyerɛdɛ mmepɔ so,
wɔtetɛ yɛn ɛserɛ so.
20 # Yer 52.8, 11 Yɛn hwene mu ahome,
deɛ AWURADE asra no no,
wɔakyere no wɔn amena mu,
ɔno a yɛkaa sɛ:
Ne nwunu ase na yɛbɛnya nkwa,
amanaman mu no.
21 # Kwa 1.21; Dwom 137.7; Yer 25.15, 21 Ma wo ho nsane wo na w’ani nnye,
Edom babaa a wote Us asase soɔ no;
wo nso wo so na amanehunu no rebɛtwam aba,
wobɛboro na w’adagya ada adi.
22 # Yes 40.2 O Sion babaa, w’amumuyɛ so akatua asa!
Ɔremma wo nkɔ so ntena otukorɔ mu;
nanso, Edom babaa, ɔbɛba abɛtua w’amumuyɛ so ka,
ɔbɛyi wo bɔne so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
